msItem.title: Heavily ciphered dispatch from Paris
msItem.author: Filippo Cavriana
msItem.note: A long dispatch of four written sides, roughly a third of it in numeric cipher with interlinear decipherment in a second hand. The clear passages touch on the siege of La Rochelle and its defenders, the Duke of Alba's position in the Low Countries, movements in Holland and Zeeland, and the affairs of England.

layoutDesc.p: Single column across two folios, written on both sides; fol. 347r blank, fol. 347v the address panel

handDesc.handNote: Hand of Filippo Cavriana, text and cipher

additions.p: Address on fol. 347v: All'Ill.moIllustrissimo s.orsignore mio s. oss.mosignore osservandissimo il s.orsignore Bartolomeo Concino, di conti della Corona, primo segretario di loro AA. Ser.meAltezze Serenissime. Fiorenza.

editorialDecl.p: Named entities are annotated according to the project authority files.
The opening salute, the dateline, the subscription and the address have been read from the facsimile and are transcribed below.

Passages in numeric cipher are encoded as seg with type "cipher" in the hand of the writer; the interlinear decipherment supplied by the chancery hand follows each group as an add with type "decipher" pointing back to the cipher group.
Cipher groups that run over a line ending carry the lb inside the seg; the accompanying decipherment, which is likewise broken in the manuscript, is given whole in a single add.
